actual.titulo: The Killer Beside Me • Screaming Terror
actual.descripcion: Screaming Terror | Alice Hufnagle is raped and murdered on Nov. 22, 2002; after following numerous leads and dead ends, police find the vital clues that lead them to Jeffery Vample, Alice's co-worker at a local pharmacy.

siguiente.titulo: The Killer Beside Me • Roadside Murder
siguiente.descripcion: Roadside Murder | Theresa Wesolowski, 22, is murdered on May 29, 1999; police are baffled for nearly 10 years before finally getting a break when a new DNA technique identifies Wesolowski's coworker, Mark Libecki, as her killer.

lista.titulo: Fatal Vows • Bored to Death
lista.descripcion: Bored to Death | When Opal Skidmore marries Steven Williams, their love is a second chance for the pair to live out their dreams; soon, boredom and the lure of the open road spark hidden desires and sexual hijinks, leaving this open marriage anything but happy.

lista.titulo: Fatal Vows • Behind Closed Doors
lista.descripcion: Behind Closed Doors | Nurses Lara Crockett and Ricardo Muscolino meet on the night shift; he sets about creating a rich life for them, and she's happy to go along with it; Ricardo's scheming eventually drives Lara into the arms of another man with explosive results.

lista.titulo: Fatal Vows • Murder, Modesty, and the Pastor
lista.descripcion: Murder, Modesty, and the Pastor | Corinne Stoudt gets a second chance at love with husband Calvin, then a too-close roommate and a monstrous past turn this second chance into a deadly battleground.

lista.titulo: People Magazine Investigates • Highway of Horrors
lista.descripcion: Highway of Horrors | In 1992, a college student disappears after her car breaks down on the highway; family and friends join police in a frantic search that hits one setback after another; it may take new advances in DNA technology to finally crack this stubborn case.

lista.titulo: People Magazine Investigates • The Price of Fame
lista.descripcion: The Price of Fame | In 2001, actor Robert Blake finds his new wife, Bonny Lee Bakley, shot in the head in the couple's car; the largest homicide investigation in LAPD history uncovers a story of blind ambition and betrayal.

lista.titulo: People Magazine Investigates • Jenner Beach Murders
lista.descripcion: Jenner Beach Murders | A Christian couple's weekend getaway takes a tragic turn when they are found murdered on a northern California beach; satanic imagery found nearby leads local sheriff's deputies on a manhunt.

lista.titulo: People Magazine Investigates • Red Christmas
lista.descripcion: Red Christmas | In December 2003, police respond to a mysterious 911 call at a home in Mansfield, Texas; when authorities enter, they discover two bodies; the key to finding the killer is within one of the victim's grasp.

lista.titulo: People Magazine Investigates • Blood Ties
lista.descripcion: Blood Ties | A college student who is working as a radio station intern is murdered, launching a long and frustrating investigation that leaves family and police on the brink of hopelessness; forensic genealogy leads to a man who has been on the run for decades.

lista.titulo: People Magazine Investigates • A Crimson End
lista.descripcion: A Crimson End | Two members of a prominent family are murdered in Arkansas, and a teenager is arrested; for 24 years, one woman believes the teen is innocent.

lista.titulo: People Magazine Investigates • Looking for Angela
lista.descripcion: Looking for Angela | In Prairie Village, Kan., a reclusive mother goes missing in 2019; when her teenage daughter and the police go looking for answers, they are gaslit at every turn; without a digital footprint or even a friend who knows her, leads are running out fast.

lista.titulo: Mean Girl Murders • Tough Cookies
lista.descripcion: Tough Cookies | At the cookie factory, friendships rise fast but so do rivalries; what starts as harmless gossip between co-workers soon turns sour; when jealousy and ambition boil over, the sweet life at the plant ends in cold-blooded murder.

lista.titulo: Hollywood Demons • Child Stars Gone Wild
lista.descripcion: Child Stars Gone Wild | Child actors struggle with the constant pressure of fame and the dangers it can bring to people exposed at such a young age; from experiencing onset perversion, suicidal thoughts and Hollywood exile, some young actors are led to make a life-altering career change after they step out of the spotlight: adult entertainment; Dan Benson ("Wizards of Waverly Place"), Maitland Ward ("Boy Meets World") and Scott Schwartz ("The Toy and A Christmas Story") open up about their careers.

lista.descripcion: Fire in the Desert | Albuquerque, N.M., mail carrier Marilyn Gandert disappears for days and no one knows where she has gone; when her body is found in the desert, detectives must find the murderer, and they only have a few witnesses beyond Marilyn's family members.
